notes.title: Summer Update v0.70
notes.content:
Redesigned Enemy AI behavior - now they tend to surround more.

Lot of bug fixes (mostly enemy behavior related)

New Home Theme Song

Some updated graphics

notes.title: Update v0.69
notes.content:
Some Tick code is rewritten to save CPU power.
 More outfits for some enemies.
 Enemy management is rewritten (dead bodies disappear which makes new game modes possible). 
 and some minor tweaks.

notes.title: Update v0.68
notes.content:
Updated (much harder) drones in basement level.
 Some more code is reorganized and rewritten for performance improvements.
 Fixed bug: basement level sometimes not ending after all drones destroyed.

notes.title: Game of Drones Update
notes.content:
New Basement level,
Plasma Shooting Drones,
Bullets can be blocked/stopped.
Minor fixes
Speed tweaks and some blueprint code is rewritten in C++

notes.title: Plans for the New Year
notes.content:
Happy New Year Everybody!

Our plans for the New Year include:

 At least two new levels
 Achievements
 More game modes
 Support for additional VR headsets
 More interactions and interactivity
 Various improvements based on your feedback and requests

notes.title: Version 0.59
notes.content:
Happy New Year!


 New NPC physical animations.
 Improved parry mechanics


Fighting should be more fun now. All the feedback is welcome!

Image from the new "Rooftop" level that is coming soon!

notes.title: Update 0.55 is live:
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36032327/39e08208b4ac7cc9ecbc0dcb0a87f221473dd587.png

Dummy Boxing Bag is now Punch-O-Meter. You can test your hitting speed (Time dilation corrected).
Damage now depends on hitting speed.
NPC behavior and animations are updated with minor changes.
Some minor optimizations in NPC code.


NB! Please be aware of your surroundings:
not to hurt yourself or other persons!
not to hurt animals or other living beings!
not to break windows, glass, electronics or any other items!

Have Fun!

notes.title: Version 0.54
notes.content:
Settings menu divided to Settings and Graphics
 Added option to turn off Auto Bullet Time

Weapons do not hurt the player anymore
 Enemy is released when grabbed and headbutted
 Small tweaks

notes.title: Update 0.52 is live:
notes.content:
Added option to hide healthbars and combo numbers (which also saves some CPU power)
 Some PBR materials are updated (still not perfect but a step forward).


NB! All versions (Full, Demo, Playtest) are updated.

Bugs, Feedback and Requests are welcome in our discord.

notes.title: Update 0.51 (public playtest gold) is live:
notes.content:
Shadows are rebuilt in some of the levels.
 The club is now cleaned up and there is now more walking room.
 Music volume saving/loading is also fixed.
 The lucky K.O. hit is removed. But it may return.
 Hit to back of the head only K.O. is added. As everybody with martial arts background should know - hits you do not see coming will K.O.


Demo version is also updated. The only difference is that demo contains only subway levels. 

Bugs, Feedback and Requests are welcome in our discord.

notes.title: Update 0.50 (public playtest candidate) is live:
notes.content:
Fallen enemies are not obstacles anymore and can be walked over.
 All enemies can be teleported through for now. Maybe this will change with difficulty level in later versions.
 Sleeping/waking time bugfix (enemies won't wake up during ground and pound)
 There's a chance (depending on enemy skill level) for a lucky K.O. hit to the enemy head

notes.title: Update 0.49 is live:
notes.content:
Vibration added,
 Vibration on/off setting added,
 Music volume setting added,
 VR menu resets to main page every time opened,
 Bugfix: some settings were not saved

notes.title: Update 0.48 is live:
notes.content:
Some textures are now higher resolution
 Improved reaction logic

notes.title: Version 0.41 is live:
notes.content:
Version 0.41 is live:
* Fixed boot kick does multiple hits.
* Improved weapon physics.
* New tools (crowbar, pipe wrench, shovel, sledgehammer)
* Every level has now some weapons
* Somewhat balanced weapon damages
Caution: When tools are used incorrectly, you can injure yourself!

notes.title: Physics update!
notes.content:
[olist]
 Updated NPC physical animations - no unregistered hits and better feel when beating them.
 Player has invisible physical body now which means that NPCs can't go inside and through the player anymore.
 Red screen tint with slow motion.
 And some more minor improvements.
[/olist]
